item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Defines `BaseQA` with one input (`question`) and one output (`answer`), then derives new signatures via `prepend`/`append` on that base signature."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Prepends input `context` to the input section and asserts `list(sig.input_fields.keys()) == [\"context\", \"question\"]`."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Prepends output `reasoning` before `answer`, appends `confidence` after it, and asserts `list(sig.output_fields.keys()) == [\"reasoning\", \"answer\", \"confidence\"]`."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Uses DSPy’s ordered mappings `sig.input_fields` and `sig.output_fields` to verify preserved insertion order directly."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Renders `system_message` via `ChatAdapter().format_system_message(sig)`, prints it, and asserts ordered field-name positions within the rendered text."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
